The injured were taken to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital where doctors declared Jewel dead, he said. In Chapainawabganj, a person was killed when a three-wheeler overturned at Baghdapara village in Shibganj upazila on Tuesday morning. The deceased was identified as Sadiqul, 48, son of late Khairul of the village. Sub-inspector Abdur Razzak of Sadar Police Station said Sadiqul was going to the district town by the three wheeler when it overturned after its driver lost control over the staring, leaving him critically injured. Later, he was taken to the Sadar Hospital where doctors declared him dead, the SI added.>
column9: <Sylhet-Sunamganj highway at Mahtabpur in Bisawnath upazila>

column4: <Bank official, madrasah teacher among 3 killed in road crashes>
column5: <Dhaka, Jan 1 (UNB) â€“ Three people, including a bank official and a madrasah teacher, have been killed and six others injured in separate road accidents in Lalmonirhat, Sylhet and Chapainawabganj districts. In Lalmonirhat, the branch manager of a private bank was killed as a truck crashed into his motorcycle at Aamtala Bazar in Hatibandha upazila on Tuesday morning. The deceased was identified as Shahin Sahed, 38, manager of Hatibandha branch of Prime Bank Ltd and son of late Shamsuddin of Chak Gopal area in Joypurhat district. The accident left the bank official dead on the spot, said Omar Faruque, officer-in-charge of Hatibandha Police Station. In Sylhet, a madrasah teacher was killed and six people were injured as a bus hit an auto-rickshaw on Sylhet-Sunamganj highway at Mahtabpur in Bisawnath upazila on Monday night. The deceased was identified as Fazlur Rahman Jewel, 45, a teacher of Darul Azhar Model Madrasah in Sylhet city and son of Tahid Mia of Pratappur village Dowarabazar upazila of Sunamganj. The Sunamganj-bound bus hit the auto-rickshaw around 9 pm, leaving seven people injured, said sub-inspector Ranu Miah, in-charge of Jaykalas Highway Police. The injured were taken to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital where doctors declared Jewel dead, he said. In Chapainawabganj, a person was killed when a three-wheeler overturned at Baghdapara village in Shibganj upazila on Tuesday morning. The deceased was identified as Sadiqul, 48, son of late Khairul of the village. Sub-inspector Abdur Razzak of Sadar Police Station said Sadiqul was going to the district town by the three wheeler when it overturned after its driver lost control over the staring, leaving him critically injured. Later, he was taken to the Sadar Hospital where doctors declared him dead, the SI added.>

column4: <Motorcyclist killed in Hatirjheel road crash>
column5: <Dhaka, Dec 24 (UNB) â€“A motorcyclist was killed and another injured as their vehicle crashed into a road divider in Hatirjheel area early Monday. The deceased was identified as Rifat, 18, son of Md Liton Miah, and the injured is Sajib, 19, residents of AgargaonTaltola government staff quarter. Sub-inspector Md Baccu Miah, in-charge of Dhaka Medical College Hospital Police outpost, said the motorbike skidded off the road hitting the divider, leaving the duo critically injured. The injured were rushed to the hospital where doctors declared Rifat dead.>

column4: <Saudi expat killed in Chandpur road crash>
column5: <A Saudi expatriate was killed and two others were injured on Saturday afternoon when a microbus collided with a CNG-run auto-rickshaw in Matlab Uttar upazila of Chandpur district. The deceased Nurul Islam, son of late Sahid Ullah Pradhan, was a resident of Fatehpur West Union of the upazila. The accident occurred when the Chandpur bound CNG autorickshaw collided head-on with the microbus, leaving expat Nurul Islam dead on the spot and two others injured, said Mohammad Shahid Hossain, officer-in-Charge (OC) of Matlab Uttar Police Station. Injured Mofizul Islam, 30, and Md. Ali Akbar, 55, were taken to Chandpur Government General Hospital. Police seized the microbus from the spot but its driver managed to flee, added the OC.>

column4: <In March alone, 42 people died in road accidents in Sylhet>
column5: <In the month of March alone, at least 42 people died, and 98 others were injured in 36 road crashes in the Sylhet division. Nirapad Sarak Chai (NISCHA), a voluntary social organisation dedicated to ensuring safe roads, revealed this information in a statement signed by Zahirul Islam Mishu, co-organising secretary of the NISCHA Central Committee, member secretary of the Sylhet Divisional Committee, and convener of Sylhet District. Of the deceased, Sylhet district witnessed the most casualties, with 20 deaths and 45 injuries in 15 road accidents. In Sunamganj, eight people died, and 17 were injured in eight road accidents, while in Moulvibazar, six people died, and three were injured in six road accidents. Additionally, road crashes left eight people dead and 33 injured in seven road accidents in Habiganj district. NISCHA provided this information based on reports published in local dailies, online portals, national dailies, and their own sources from the Sylhet branch. Among the 42 deceased were 13 motorcyclists and pillion riders, eight CNG-run autorickshaw and Laguna drivers and passengers, and six pedestrians who died in road accidents in Sylhet division in March. Apart from this, six people died in five accidents due to the loss of control of vehicles, 17 people died in nine accidents due to head-on collisions, and four people died in five accidents due to hitting trees and electric poles. Among the victims were 28 men, nine women, and five children, read the statement. In February, 26 people died, and 66 were injured in 25 accidents in the Sylhet division.>
column19: <(loss of control, collision, hitting trees, hitting electric poles)>

column4: <3 die in separate road accidents in Ctg>
column5: <Three people including an imam, died in separate road accidents in Chattogram's Raozan and Hathazari upazilas on Tuesday. The deceased were identified as Syedul Haque, 4,Md Miraz, 2,and Md Faruk, 26. In Raozan, Imam Syedul Haque died and another Imam was injured after their motorcycle collided with a CNG-run autorickshaw. Syedul Haque was the Pesh Imam of the Aylikhil Baytun Noor Jame Mosque in Raozan. According to an eyewitness, the autorickshaw collided with the motorcycle, causing the autorickshaw to overturn and fall into a ditch.  Zainal Abedin, sub-inspector of Raozan Police Station, Said, “We went to the spot after receiving the information. One was found dead, and the other was sent to the hospital. The two vehicles were impounded."  In Hathazari, two motorcyclists, Miraz and Faruk, died after being hit by an ambulance. They were declared dead after being brought around 8:30 pm, said Dr Arefin Azim of the Hathazari Upazila Health Complex.>

column4: <Two die in separate road accidents in Ctg>
column5: <Two people died in separate road accidents in Rangunia and Boalkhali upazilas of Chattogram on Thursday. The deceased were identified as Mohammad Abdul Hannan, 34, a CNG-run autorickshaw driver and Azizur Rahman, 38, a truck driver. In Rangunia, a fish-laden truck collided with a CNG auto-rickshaw on the Chattogram-Kaptai road at 9:00 am killing the autorickshaw driver on the spot and injuring three passengers. Police rushed to the spot and took the injured to the local Upazila Health Complex, said Abdullah Al Mamun, sub-inspector of Rangunia Police Station.Two vehicles involved in the accident have been seized but the truck driver fled the spot, he added.In Boalkhali, a truck driver died when his truck overturned in a paddy field on Kanungopara Sreepur Bura Masjid road in Boalkhali early Thursday. The truck lost control and fell into the field beside ther road, said Nur-e-Alam, sub-inspector of Boalkhali Police Station.Later, the body was taken to Patiya, he said.>
column9: <(Chattogram-Kaptai road, Kanungopara Sreepur Bura Masjid road)>

column4: <2 killed in separate accidents in Sylhet and Chandpur>
column5: <Two people were killed in separate road accidents in Sylhet and Chandpur district on Tuesday. A pedestrian was killed after being hit by a pickup truck on Sylhet-Tamabil road in Jaintapur upazila of the district. The incident took place in front of Shahjalal College gate of Chiknagul union around 8:15 pm . The identity of the deceased could not be known immediately. Jaintapur Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Tajul Islam said a man died after being hit by a pickup. The highway police have been informed that they are going to the spot. In Chandpur, a brick kiln worker named Manik Mia, 40, was killed after being hit by a BRTC passenger bus in Kachua. He used to work as a labourer in the local brick kiln. The accident took place on the road adjacent to Selim's shop in East Kalcho Bhuiyan Bari of Kachua upazila on Tuesday afternoon. Kachua Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mizanur Rahman said the deceased was a resident of Nogal village in Derai upazila of Sunamganj. Locals said the Dhaka-bound BRTC bus from Hajiganj hit him while he was crossing the road . Later, locals rescued and rushed him to Kachua Upazila Health Complex where doctors declared him dead.>
column9: <(Sylhet-Tamabil road in front of Shahjalal College gate of Chiknagul union,  road adjacent to Selim's shop in East Kalcho Bhuiyan Bari)>

column4: <4 dead in accident on Dhaka-Ctg Highway in Cumilla>
column5: <Four people were killed and three were injured in a road accident on Dhaka-Chattogram Highway in Chandina upazila of Cumilla early Tuesday. The accident occurred in Belasar area of Chandina at 5:30 am today. The deceased were identified as Monir Hossain, Habibur Rahman, Akhter Hossain and Rafiqul Islam. Manjurul Alam Mollah, officer-in-charge of Eliotganj Highway Police Station said that a Dhaka- bound truck carrying fish from Noakhali overturned and collided with a parked truck in Chandina's Belasar area. Four workers on the truck were crushed and died on the spot, he added. The injured were taken to Dhaka for better treatment, said the OC.>

column4: <3 dead, 10 injured in Faridpur bus accident>
column5: <Three people died and at least 10 others were injured when a passenger bus overturned in Bhanga upazila of Faridpur early Friday morning. The incident happened at Babnatala Bus Stand area on the Dhaka-Barishal Highway of the upazila. Upon receiving the news, members of the Bhanga Fire Service and Highway Police rushed to the scene, rescued the injured, and admitted them to the Bhanga Upazila Health Complex. The bodies of the deceased were recovered and taken to the police station, said Bhanga Fire Service Station Manager Abu Zafar. The Dhaka-bound bus named Imran Travels (Dhaka Metro-B-12-3020) that left Barishal on Thursday night lost control and overturned on the road. The bus was completely mangled, and the passengers inside were trapped, killing two people at the scene, he said. One of the deceased was identified as Shafikul Islam Suruj (45) of Pannduria village in Santhia Upazila of Pabna. Assistant Sub-inspector Abu Saeed of Bhanga Highway Police confirmed the matter. The identities of the other two deceased are yet to be found, he said.>

column4: <Cop among 3 dead in Sylhet, Habiganj road accidents>
column5: <Three people including a policeman died in separate road accidents in Sylhet and Habiganj districts on Sunday. Masudul Amin, officer-in-charge of Golapganj Model Police Station, said a speeding bus crashed into cop Abul Hossain's motorbike in front of Dreamland Park in the upazila, leaving him dead on the spot. The constable, aged 27, came to his village home on leave. Masudul Amin said they recovered the body and sent it to Osmani Medical College Hospital morgue for autopsy. Legal actions will be taken in this regard. In Habiganj, two more people died and other three were injured in a head-on collision between a truck and a CNG-run autorickshaw on Dhaka-Sylhet highway in Nabiganj upazila of the district in the afternoon. The victims were Akib Mia, 62, and Surchan Begum, 36, both hailing from Mithamoin upazila of Kishoreganj. Parimal Chandra Dev, officer-in-charge of Sherpur Highway Police Station, said the head-on collision between the truck and the autorickshaw carrying the five left two dead on the spot and three others injured in Aushkandi Mithapur under the upazila in the afternoon. The injured were sent to Nabiganj Upazila Health Complex, said the OC. Vehicular movement on the highway remained suspended for around one hour following the accident, he added.>

column4: <2 die in road accident in Sylhet>
column5: <Two people, including a woman, were killed and four more injured in a head-on collision between a pickup van and a CNG-run autorickshaw on the Dhaka-Sylhet highway in Dakshin Surma upazila of Sylhet on Thursday afternoon. The deceased were identified as Nazma Begum, 43, wife of Sona Mia of Companiganj upazila of the district and autorickshaw driver Mansur Ali, 27, son of Dhanai Mia of Pirer Bazar Borni village of the same district’s Bishwanath upazila. Witnesses said the upazila-bound autorickshaw from Sylhet city collided with a pickup van coming from the opposite direction on the highway in Lalbazar area, leaving six people injured. Locals rescued the injured and sent them to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital where the duo breathed their last. Confirming the matter, the hospital police outpost’s in-charge Jafar Imam said the bodies were kept at the morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <Woman among 2 die in separate road accidents in C’nawabganj>
column5: <Two people, including a woman, died in separate road accidents in Chapainawabganj Sadar upazila on Friday morning. The deceased were identified as Khairunnesa, 65, wife of Ruhul Amin of Chaipara Nimgachhi area of Sadar municipality and Rafi, 8, son of Kawsar of Kalinagar area of Shibganj upazila of the district. Confirming the accidents, Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mintoo Rahman said a sand-laden truck ran over the woman while crossing a road in the Malopara area around 11 am, leaving her dead on the spot. The body was sent to the Sadar hospital morgue for an autopsy, he said. Meanwhile, a speeding motorbike hit an autorickshaw carrying the boy from behind at the Shibtala intersection of the district headquarters around 10:30 am, leaving him critically injured. He succumbed to his injuries on the way to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital from Sadar Hospital, the OC said. Legal action will be taken in this regard, he added.>

column4: <Six cops injured in road accident during vehicle check in Sylhet>
column5: <During a routine vehicle inspection on the Sylhet-Sunamganj road at Temukhi, Sylhet district, six policemen sustained injuries when a bus hit them early Thursday (February 15, 2024) morning. The incident occurred as the officers were operating a check-post established to enhance road safety measures. The injured officers include Azbahar Ali Sheikh, Additional DIG and Deputy Commissioner of Sylhet Metropolitan Polic,Kawsar Dastagir, Additional Deputy Commissione,Zahurul Islam, Assistant Commissioner of Airport Police Statio,SM Nunu Mia, Officer-in-Charge of Airport Police Statio,Rezul Karim, Assistant Sub-Inspecto,and driver Nayek Habibur Rahman. According to Zakir Hossain, Commissioner of Sylhet Metropolitan Police, the accident happened around 6 am when a 'Real Coach' bus from Sunamganj, while undergoing checks, struck the policemen, causing various degrees of injuries. The victims received immediate medical attention at a local hospital, with Azbahar Ali Sheikh being admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) for further treatment. Following the incident, police detained the bus supervisor and impounded the vehicle. However, the bus driver managed to escape from the scene. Authorities are currently investigating the accident and have initiated efforts to apprehend the fleeing driver.>

column4: <Road accident kills ex-UP chairman in Chuadanga>
column5: <A former Union Parishad chairman was killed in a road accident in Chuadanga's Darshana upazila on Wednesday. The deceased was identified as Abdul Kasem, 75, former chairman of Karpasdanga Union Parishad. He was a resident of Aramdanga village of the upazila and  son of Ahmed Ali Mondol. The accident occurred around 3:30 pm on Darshana-Mujibnagar road at Ramnagar junction of Darshana municipality, said Biplab Kumar Saha, officer-in-charge (OC) Darshana Police Station. Eyewitnesses said that on the way to Darshana from his home in Alamdanga, Karpasdanga, he lost control of his motorcycle and crashed into a building on the side of the road. Locals rescued and took him to the Darshana Mukti Clinic where doctors declared him dead on arrival. On information, family members took the body to their home. He served as a two-time chairman of the union parishad elected in 1992 and 2011.>

column4: <Feni level crossing crash: Death toll rises to 6>
column5: <The death toll from the crash involving a running train hitting a truck on a level crossing in Purbo Fazilpur Muhuriganj Bridge area under Feni’s Sadar upazila rose to six, as four more people succumbed to their injuries. The victims were identified as Sajjad, 20, son of Yachin, Rifat, 19, son of Ruhul Amin, Deen Mohammad, 19, son of Surul Islam, and Ashiq of Shaktala village of Chauddagram upazila of Cumilla. Feni’s Superintendent of Police Md Jakir Hasan confirmed the deaths. Police and witnesses said the accident happened around 8:30 am when the Chattogram-bound mail train hit the truck while it was crossing the rail track as the gateman failed to place the bar despite the arrival of the train in the Muhuriganj Bridge area. The impact of the accident left truck driver Mizan, 32, son of Abul Howladar of Uzirpur upazila of Barishal and its helper Abul Khair, 40, son of Amir Hossain of Manoharpur of Comilla dead on the spot, they said. The bodies were sent to Feni Sadar Hospital morgue for autopsies. Gateman Md Saiful went missing soon after the accident, Jakir Hasan added.>

column4: <Pabna univ teacher’s wife and son die in Naogaon road crash on way to celebrate Eid>
column5: <The wife and minor son of a teacher of Pabna University of Science and Technology (PUST) died in a road crash in Naogaon’s Manda upazila on Thursday. Teacher Firoz Ali and his seven-year-old daughter also sustained injuries in the crash. He is an assistant professor of the university’s Electrical and Electronic Engineering department. The deceased were identified as Reshma Begum, 32, and her eight-month-old son Farabi. Dr Nazmul Hossain, director at the student advisor department of the university, said his colleague's family met the accident on their way to village home in Naogaon from Rajshahi to celebrate the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitre. The accident happened around 10:30 am when a speeding pickup van crashed into a CNG-run autorickshaw carrying the family members in the Manda upazila, leaving Farabi dead on the spot and three others injured, he said. Injured Reshma was rushed to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital where she succumbed to her injuries around 9 pm while undergoing treatment, said the director, adding that the teacher’s hands got broken and his daughter’s hands and legs also got fractured. The university authority including Vice Chancellor Prof Dr Hafiza Khatun expressed deep shock at the sad demise of their colleague’s wife and son.>

column4: <Minor boy killed in Dhaka road crash>
column5: <A 10-year-old boy was killed in a road crash in Dhaka’s Kamrangirchar area on Sunday morning. The deceased was identified as Mashruful Hasan, son of Md Mamun of Noakhali district. Quoting Tanvir Hossain, a pedestrian, Inspector Bachhu Mia, in-charge of Dhaka Medical College and Hospital police camp, said the accident occurred around 11 am when a goods laden van ran over the boy as he fell on the road after being hit by a human hauler while crossing road, leaving him injured. Later, he was taken to Dhaka Medical College and Hospital where the doctors declared him dead at noon. The body was taken to the hospital morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <3 killed in Magura road crash>
column5: <Three people were killed and seven others were injured when a bus hit a human hauler at Hazambari in Salikha upazila of Magura district on Friday. The deceased were identified as Madhu Shikdar, 55, son of Kalipodo Shikdar, Nilufa Dey, 50, wife of Nitai Dey and Pushpa Rani Dey, wife of Narayan Chandra Dey of Bagherpara upazila in Jashore district. Mehedi Hasan, officer-in-charge of Magura Sadar Police Station, said the accident occurred around 9 pm on Friday when the Jashore-bound bus hit the human hauler, leaving two killed on the spot and eight others injured. The injured were taken to Magura 250-bed Hospital where the doctors declared Madhu dead.>

column4: <Four killed in road accidents in Noakhali and Kushtia>
column5: <At least four people were killed and another sustained injuries in separate road accidents in Noakhali and Kushtia on Friday. In Noakhali, an unidentified elderly woman was killed alongside the minor girl who was helping her to cross the road, as they were hit by a speeding truck in Sonapur area on Friday afternoon. The girl was identified as Jannatul Ferdaus, 8, daughter of Zaker Hossain of Char Karam Ulya village of Sadar Upazila, and a 60-year-old unidentified beggar. Eyewitnesses said the elderly woman lived in the Sonapur area and used to be seen asking for alms at times. She was visually impaired, and Jannatul often helped her to cross the road in the evenings. On this occasion as they were crossing the road, the speeding truck hit them in Sonapur old bus stand area, leaving them seriously injured. Locals rushed them to the 250-bed Noakhali General Hospital, where doctors on duty declared them dead. Mohammad Riaz Hasan, sub-inspector (SI) of Sudharam Police Station, said the body of the old woman was sent to the hospital morgue for an autopsy. And the body of the child has been handed over to her family after due procedure. Legal action will be taken upon receiving a written complaint, added the officer. In Kushtia, a woman and her son were killed and her husband was left injured, after being hit by a drum truck in Kushtia’s Kumarkhali upazila this evening. The deceased were identified as Mst. Salma Khatun, 40, wife of Army person Rahmat Ali, and their son Sawron, 12, from Paikpara area of Chapra Union in Kumarkhali Upazila. Kumarkhali Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Akibul Islam said that Rahmat Ali was returning home in Paikpara of Kumarkhali upazila from the town on a motorcycle with his wife and son. When they reached the Bandhbazar area, the drum truck hit the motorcycle and the impact knocked them off the bike, leaving Salma Khatun and her son dead on the spot. The seriously injured Rahmat Ali was admitted to Kushtia General Hospital, the OC added. On information, police recovered the bodies and sent them to Kushtia General Hospital morgue. Dr Tapas Kumar Sarkar, resident medical officer (RMO) of Kushtia General Hospital, said the condition of Rahmat Ali, who was injured in the road accident, is critical.>

column4: <Man dies in Gazipur road crash>
column5: <An unidentified man was killed and another injured when a private car hit a van on Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway in South Salna in Gazipur district on Tuesday. Rafiul Karim, officer-in-charge of Sadar Police Station, said the accident occurred in the morning when the Dhaka-bound private car hit the van of a bakery shop, leaving its driver killed on the spot and another injured. The injured pedestrian was taken to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmed Medical College and Hospital. Police recovered the body and sent it to the local hospital morgue for autopsy. Police also seized the private car but could not arrest its driver as he managed to flee the scene.>

column4: <2 people killed in Ctg road crash>
column5: <Two people were killed in a road accident on Dhaka-Chattogram highway in Chattogram’s Mirsharai on Sunday. The deceased were identified as Abdur Rahim, 47, driver of a covered van, and Masum Billah, 42, owner of a cargo truck. The crash occurred on Sunday morning in Nizampur Ridwan Filling Station area on Chattogram-bound Lane. Eyewitnesses said that the driver and owner of the covered van were killed on the spot when a speeding mini-covered van hit the back of a cargo truck in the morning. On information, police rushed to the spot and recovered the bodies, said Md Alamgir Hossain, sub-inspector of Kumira Highway Police Station. The families of the victims have been informed. The crash might have occurred due to the driver's drowsiness, added the SI.>

column4: <Transport employee killed in Jatrabari road crash>
column5: <A 50-year-old employee of a transport operator was killed when two buses collided in the capital's Jatrabari area on Wednesday afternoon. The deceased was identified as Mohammad Rakibul Hasan Nasir, the counter manager of Bonphool Paribahan. The deceased’s colleague Md Sumon Mia said a bus of Setu Deluxe Transport and another of Bonful Paribaha collided in front of Jatrabari Narail counter, leaving Rakibul seriously  injured. Later, he was taken to the emergency department of DhakaMedical College Hospital (DMCH) where doctors declared him dead around 5:30 pm, said Md Bachchu Mia, in-charge of DMCH police outpost. The body has been kept at Dhaka Medical College Hospital(DMCH) morgue for autopsy, he said.>

column4: <2 dead in Sherpur road crash>
column5: <Two people were killed and 10 others injured in a collision between a speeding bus and a three-wheeler in Sreebardi upazila of Sherpur district early Wednesday. The deceased were identified as three-wheeler helper Hamidullah, 26, son of late Mofiz Uddin of Boro poragor village under the Sreebardi upazila and bus passenger Golam Faruk, 50, son of Abdul Barek of nearby Jamalpur’s Bakshiganj upazila. Sreebardi police station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Kaium Khan Siddique said the bus of ‘Ma Moni Paribahan’ crashed into the three-wheeler coming from the opposite direction on Bhayadanga-Kurua road around 5 am, leaving the helper dead on the spot and 11 others injured. The injured were rushed to Sherpur Sadar hospital where Faruk succumbed to his injuries and the rest were undergoing treatment, he said. After the collision, the three-wheeler, locally used for transporting goods, plunged into a roadside ditch while the bus  ploughed through a nearby house, the OC said. The bus was seized but its driver managed to flee, he said, adding that a legal action will be taken.>

column4: <Duet teacher among 2 killed in Gazipur road crash>
column5: <Two people including a teacher of Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology (Duet), were killed when a bus hit a motorbike at Cherag Ali Market in Tongi of Gazipur district on Tuesday. One of the deceased was identified as Ramchandra Saha, a teacher of the Architecture Department of Duet while the identity of another could not be known immediately. The accident occurred around 11:30 am when the Dhaka-bound bus rammed the motorbike carrying two people, leaving them injured, said Mustafizur Rahman, officer-in-charge of Tongi East Police Station. Later, they were taken to a local hospital where the doctors declared them dead. The bodies were sent to the hospital morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <Motorcyclist killed in Rajshahi road crash>
column5: <A motorcyclist was killed when a trolley hit a motorbike at Madhukhali East Baliadanga in Puthia upazila of Rajshahi district. The deceased was identified as Kabil Soleman, 55, son of Tamij Uddin of Natore district. Saidur Rahman, officer-in-charge of Puthia Police Station, said the accident occurred around 7:45 am in front of the residence of one Abed Ali when the engine-run trolley dashed the motorbike from behind, leaving Soleman dead on the spot. None was arrested as the driver of the trolley went into hiding.>
column9: <front of the residence of one Abed Ali>

column4: <Pedestrian dies in Lalmonirhat road crash>
column5: <A 37-year-old man died after a speeding truck ran him over in Aditmari upazila of Lalmonirhat last night. The deceased was Sirajul Islam, the son of Abdul Miah of Saftibari Chowratari village of the upazila. Aditmari Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mahmud-Un-Nabi confirmed the matter, saying that the accident occurred on Thursday night when the truck hit the pedestrian on his way home in the Khatapara area, leaving him dead on the spot. Trucker Rahmat Ali, 27, was detained in this connection, he added.>

column4: <2 dead, 7 more injured in Sylhet road crash>
column5: <Two people were killed and seven others injured in a head-on collision between a tractor and a CNG-run autorickshaw in Gowainghat upazila of Sylhet on Thursday evening. Deceased Nazrul Islam, 50, and Jasir Uddin, 65, were residents of Korni and Lengura villages respectively of the upazila. Five of the injured are Alim Uddin, 40, Rahmatullah, 30, his son Raihan, 10, Jasim Uddin, 28, and Marjahan Ahmad, 30. Locals said some people were returning to Upazila sadar from a waz mahfil (religious gathering) from Laughut area by the autorickshaw. The accident happened around 6:30 pm when the tractor crashed into the autorickshaw coming from the opposite direction in Purnanagar area, leaving nine people including the autorickshaw driver injured. Of them, Nazrul breathed his last on the way to a hospital while Jasir succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment, they said. Gowainghat police station Officer-in-Charge Rafiqul Islam confirmed the matter saying that legal actions would be taken in this regard. The injured were undergoing treatment at several hospitals, he added.>

column4: <Teenage boy killed in city road crash>
column5: <A 16-year-old teenage boy was killed after being hit by a microbus at Elephant Road in the capital on Friday night. The deceased was identified as Md Yusuf, a worker at a shoe shop and son of Ayub Ali of Hazaribagh area. The accident occurred around 9 am when the microbus hit him while crossing the road, leaving him injured, said Sabuj Mia, sub-inspector of New Market Police Station. Later, he was first taken to Popular Hospital and later shifted to Dhaka Medical College and Hospital where the doctors declared him dead around 11 pm. The body was kept at the hospital morgue, said SI.>

column4: <Bus driver killed in road crash during his break on Dhaka-Chattogram highway>
column5: <A 30-year-old bus driver was killed after being hit by a bus in Sanarpar area of Narayanganj on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway on Friday afternoon. The deceased was identified as Russel, son of Masud Sarker, from Kadirpur village of Madaripur district. Arif, another bus driver, said Russel suffered serious injury when he was hit by a passenger bus while crossing the road to smoke a cigarette after lunch on Saturday at 3:30 pm. Russel was first taken to a local hospital. Later, he was shifted to the emergency department of Dhaka Medical College Hospital for better treatment where he succumbed to his injuries at 5:20 pm. The body was kept in the hospital morgue for an autopsy, said Inspector Bachchu Mia, in-charge of Dhaka Medical College and Hospital (DMCH) police outpost.>

column4: <College student killed in Magura road crash>
column5: <A college student was killed and two others were injured in a collision between a truck and a motorbike in Sadar upazila of Magura on Saturday night. The deceased was Abir Hasan Arko, 18,  an HSC second year student of a local college and son of Lemon Sheikh of Parnanduali village under the Sadar upazila while his injured friends are Mobin, 22, and Jubayer, 19. Magura Sadar police station Officer-in-Charge Mehedi Hasan said the accident occurred 10:30 pm when the truck crashed into the bike coming from the opposite direction on Magura-Jhenaidah Highway in Kashinathpur Chara Bouttala area, leaving Abir dead on the spot and the two injured. The injured were shifted to Dhaka from Magura Sadar Hospital for better treatment, he said. Though the truck was seized but its driver managed to flee, he said, adding that a case was filed in this regard.>

column4: <Chattogram, Naogaon road crashes kill 2>
column5: <Two people were killed in separate road accidents in Chattogram and Naogaon districts on Wednesday. In Chattogram, a 48-year-old man was killed when an unknown vehicle hit a motorbike on Chattogram-Cox’s bazar highway at Mithadighi in Satkania upazila of Chattogram district. The accident occurred around 6 am today, said Sub-inspector of Dohazari highway police, Joynal Abedin. The deceased was identified as Bahar Uddin, a sweet trader and son of Altaf Mia of Chibbari in Satkania upazila. In Naogaon, a driver of a tractor died on the spot when the tractor skidded off the road as the driver lost control over it at Gobrapara in Dhamoirhat upazila of Naogaon district in the morning, said inspector Habibur Rahman of Dhamoirhat Police Station. The deceased was identified as Sufol Chandra, 32, son of Kamal Chandra.>

column4: <3 killed in Rangamati road crash>
column5: <Three people were killed and two others injured when a lorry hit a three-wheeler on Rangamati-Chattogram at Shalbagan in Rangamati upazila on Thursday morning. Two of the deceased were identified as Nabir Hossain and Md Hafiz while the identity of another could not be known immediately. Quoting witnesses, additional superintendent of Rangamati police, Maruf Ahmed, said the accident occurred in the morning when the Chattogram-bound lorry used for repairing roads hit a CNG-run auto-rickshaw, leaving one dead on the spot and four others injured. Both the vehicles fell into a ditch after the collision, he said. The injured were taken to Rangamati Sadar Hospital where two of them were declared dead. The condition of another injured victim was stated to be critical.>

column4: <3 madrasha students die in Mymensingh road crash while returning from Ijtema>
column5: <Three students of a madrasha died and 15 others sustained injuries in a road accident when they were returning to Myemensingh from Tongi’s Biswa Ijtema venue by a truck on Sunday night. The deceased were Nayeem, 13, Sanaullah Sajal, 19, and Fazlul Huq,  students of Jamia Islamia Darus Sunnah Qawmi Madrasa of Bhaluka upazila in Mymensingh district. Of them, Nayeem hailed from the district’s Gafargaon upazila while the rest from Bhaluka upazila. Bhaluka Model Police Station's Officer-in-Charge (investigation) Jahangir Alam said a total of 30 students of the madrasha went to the Ijtema venue in Tongi to join Akheri Munajat. After the munajat, when the students were returning home by the truck it overturned at Dalibari intersection around 11:30 pm, leaving Nayeem dead on the spot and 17 others injured, he said. The injured were first taken to Bhaluka upazila health complex and later shifted to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital (MMCH) when their condition deteriorated, he said. Sanaullah succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment at the MMCH, he said, adding that Fazlul also died on way to Dhaka from the hospital early Monday.>

column4: <2 siblings among 3 killed in Natore road crash>
column5: <Three people including two siblings were killed when a truck hit a three-wheeler van at Ranirhat in Singra upazila of Natore district on Monday. The deceased were identified as Husne Ara, 45, van puller Emran, 22, and his brother Rabbi, 18—two sons of Abdul Momin of Bankurail village in the upazila. The accident occurred around 11:30 am when the truck of an animal feed company crashed into a van, leaving three people dead on the spot, said Abul Kalam, officer-in-charge of Singra police station. Angered by the accident, local people vandalised the truck and seized three more trucks of the same company. On information, police brought the situation under control and sent the bodies to the local hospital morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <Motorcycle rider dies in Dinajpur road crash>
column5: <A motorcycle rider was dead and the pillion passenger injured after being hit by a covered van in Phulbari upazila of Dinajpur on Sunday morning. The deceased was identified as Jakir Hossain, 52, a construction worker and son of late Foyez Uddin of South Sabajpur in Birampur, and the injured was Rony. Rezaul Karim, sub-inspector of Phulbari Police Station said a covered van hit the motorcycle, leaving Jakir dead and Rony injured. Later, the injured was admitted to a local medical center, he added. The covered van has been seized, but the driver fled, said the SI.>

column4: <Road crash leaves 7 dead in Pirojpu,10 hurt>
column5: <-At least seven people were killed and 10 others were injured when a bus rammed into a battery-run auto-rickshaw and a motorcycle in Pirojpur's Sadar upazila on Friday. The deceased were identified as Swapan Howladar, Md Hemayet, Khairul, Nayem, Mansura Begum, Alamgir and Jasmine. The accident occurred around 11:45pm on the Pirojpur-Parerhat road in Jhautola area, said the OC of Pirojpur Sadar Police Station Md. Atikuzzaman. Pirojpur Fire Service and Civil Defense Deputy Director Md. Salim Mia said the bus left Pirojpur Bus Stand for Indurkani this morning. When it reached Jhautola around 11:45pm, it hit a battery-run auto-rickshaw from behind, and then it hit the motorcycle. “Four people died on the spot. Of them, three succumbed to their injuries on the way to Pirojpur Sadar Hospital,” he added. Pirojpur Sadar Hospital authorities said that 10 more people were injured in this incident. Of them, those seriously injured were transferred to various hospitals in Khulna and Barishal.>

column4: <Two college students die in Satkhira road crash>
column5: <Two college students died and another student was injured as a motorbike carrying them crashed into a pillar of an under-construction bridge in Assasuni upazila of Satkhira district on Wednesday morning. The deceased were identified as Nayan Ghosh, 19, son of Niranjan Ghosh of Amania villagein Kaliganj upazila and William Ghosh, 18, son of Jagannath Ghosh of the same village and the injured was Colonel Ghosh, 19, son of Tarak Ghosh of the same area. All of them were HSC second year students of Kaliganj College. According to police and locals, three friends- Nayan Ghosh, William Ghosh and Colonel Ghosh joined a programme at Jagannath Gurudev temple in Jethua Jalalpur in Tala upazila on Tuesday evening. On Wednesday morning when they were returning home from the religious event the motorbike carrying them crashed into under-construction Dhapua bridge on the Dargahpur Kadakati road and plunged into a waterbody , leaving Nayan Ghosh and William Ghosh dead on the spot and Colonel Ghosh injured. Locals allege that the contractor of the under-construction bridge has kept the work half-done, making the road risky for movement of people. Assasuni Fire Service Station Officer (Acting) Belal Hossain said they handed over the bodies and the motorcycle to police. Assasuni Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Biswajit Kumar Adhikari said police recovered the bodies and sent those to Satkhira Sadar Hospital morgue for autopsy. The injured was admitted to the Assasuni Upazila Health Complex, said the OC. Preparations are underway to take legal action after investigating the incident, he added.>

column4: <2 killed in road crash in Gaibandha>
column5: <Two people were killed in a head-on collision between a motorcycle and a truck at Nasratpur area on Saghata road in Gaibandha. The incident took place around 7:30 pm on Sunday. Masud Rana, officer-in-charge of Gaibandha Police Station, said a truck was going to Badiakhali from Gaibandha. The truck collided with a motorcycle coming from the opposite direction. Two motorcyclists were killed on the spot. The identities of the deceased could not be ascertained, he added.>

column4: <Two people die in Narsingdi road crash>
column5: <Two people died and two others were injured after a microbus collided with a stone-laned truck on the Dhaka-Sylhet highway in Shibpur upazila of Narsingdi on Thursday morning. The deceased were identified as Shah Alam, 50, of Natai village of Sadar upazila of Brahmanbaria, and his brother-in-law, Selim Mia, of the same upazila. Arifur Rahman, sub-inspector of Itakhola Highway Police Station, confirmed the matter. According to family sources, Shah Alam arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport from Italy in the early hours of Thursday after receiving the news of his mother's death. Later, four people, including Shah Alam Selim Mia and his nephew, left the airport for Brahmanbaria on the microbus around 9:30 am and met with the incident on the way. Shah Alam died on the spot, and Selim Mia died after being taken to Narsingdi District Hospital. The driver of the microbus and another passenger are undergoing treatment at Narsingdi District Hospital, said the SI. Legal action will be taken in this regard, he added.>

column4: <Two women die in separate road accidents in Chattogram>
column5: <Two women died in separate road accidents in Chandanaish upazila and in Anwara Upazila of Chattogram on Wednesday morning. One of the deceased was a 24-25-year-old unidentified woman in Anwara Upazila and another deceased was identified as Diluara Begum (45), a daily wage earner from Ward-1 of Dohazari Municipality of Chandanaish upazila, said police. The unidentified woman died when a vehicle hit her at Jheori  Mazar Gate of Anwara Upazila, said Sohel Mahmud, officer-in-Charge of Anwara Police Station. Meanwhile, in another incident in Dohazari area Ward-1, Diluara Begum died when a leguna lost control and rammed the bathroom on the side of the road, said Khan Mohammad Erfan, officer-in-charge of Dohazari Highway Police Station.>

column4: <Biker dead, two pillion riders injured in Magura road accident>
column5: <A biker was killed and two pillion riders were injured as the motorcycle carrying them collided with a  motorized van in Magura's Sreepur upazila on Monday morning. The deceased was identified as Shahin Sheikh, 28, son of Badsha Sheikh of Parla Beltola area of Magura Sadar upazila and the injured were Ashik and Suja. The accident occurred around 9 am when the motorcycle collided with the van in Radhanagar area of the upazila, leaving the trio seriously injured, said Kanchan Kumar Roy, officer-in-charge (OC) of Sreepur police station. They were taken to Magura 250-bed hospital. Shahin died while undergoing treatment at the hospital. Ashik and Suja are now receiving treatment at the hospital, added the OC. A case was filed in this regard at Sreepur police station, he said.>

column4: <Father, son dead in Kurigram road accident>
column5: <A man and his son were killed in a collision between a motorbike and a three-wheeler, locally known as nasiman, on Sonahat land port road in Bhurungamari upazila of Kurigram on Sunday morning. The deceased were Shahidul Islam, 48, and his son Biplob Hasan, 25, hailing from Sarkartari village of the upazila. Locals said the victims riding on the bike were going to their village home from Bhurungamari upazila sadar in the morning. The accident occurred when the three-wheeler crashed into the motorcycle coming from the opposite direction in Patershawari area, leaving the two critically injured, they said. They were rushed to Bhurungamari Upazila Health Complex where physicians declared them dead upon arrival. Bhurungamari police station’s Officer-in-Charge Ruhul Amin said poor visibility caused by dense fog might be the reason behind the accident.>

column4: <4 killed, 5 injured in Faridpur accident>
column5: <Four people were killed and five others injured in a bus-Laguna collision in Faridpur's Bhanga Upazila. Three of the deceased were identified as Mehedi Matubbar, 25, Hafizul Islam Habu, 40,  and Sirajul Islam, 25. The accident occurred on Dhaka-Khulna highway on Friday evening. Bhanga Highway Police Station Officer in Charge Abu Sayeed Md Khairul Anam said, the accident took place when a Dhaka-bound bus of Sohag Paribahan collided with a leguna coming from the opposite direction. Two of the injured, Rani Bala, 60, and Pabitra Bala, 35, were taken to Faridpur Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical College Hospital after their condition deteriorated.>

column4: <Motorcycle accident takes JnU student's life>
column5: <Abhijit Haldar, a student of Jagannath University, was killed in a motorcycle accident in Srinagar on his way of going Mawa on Friday (January 19) morning. Ananya Halder Antu, another student of the university who was with him, was seriously injured and admitted to Dhaka Medical. Abhijit is a student in the 2017 - 18 academic year, studied masters of the department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology at Jagannath University (JnU). At the same time, he was in charge of the General Secretary of Student Welfare at Pirojpur district. His home district is Pirojpur. The seriously injured student, Antu, is a student of the 2019 - 20 academic year, currently studying 4th year of honours in the Institute of Education and Research (IER) department at Jagannath University (JnU). In this regard, Dr. Mostafa Kamal, proctor of the university, said, "The accident happened in Srinagar on the way to Mawa. Abhijit died instantly, and Antu was brought to Dhaka Medical in a serious condition. Antu is currently being treated at Dhaka Medical and Abhi's dead body will be handed over to us by the highway police shortly after completing the legal process.">

column4: <2 people killed in separate road accidents in Chattogram>
column5: <Two people including a woman were killed in separate road accidents in Sitakunda upazila and Chattogram city on Monday. Witnesses said Parijan Bibi, 65 wife of Wahid Ullah of Makim Talukdar Bari in Colonel Hat area of the city, was killed when a bus of ‘Shyamoli Paribahan’ ran over her while crossing the road in the morning. In another incident, Md Salauddin, 52, a worker of Port-Link Container Depot and son of Habibullah of Noakhali’s  Begumganj upazila, was killed when he was hit by a container trailer at the depot in Bhatiari Banubazar of Sitakunda upazila around 7 am. Nurul Alam Ashek, in charge of Chittagong Medical College and Hospital police outpost, said both the victims were taken to the hospital where the doctors declared them dead. The bodies were kept in the hospital morgue for autopsy.>
column9: <(road in Chattogram City, depot in Bhatiari Banubazar)>

column4: <ASI killed in Mymensingh road accident>
column5: <An assistant sub-inspector died in a road accident in Mymensingh's Nandail upazila on Saturday morning. The deceased was Nur Ahmed, 38, an assistant sub-inspector of Nandail Police Station. The accident took place at around 11am in Bahadurpur area of the upazila. Nandail Police Station officer-in-charge Md Abdul Mazid said Nur was on his way to Char Betagoir area on his motorcycle. On the way, he rammed into a microbus coming from the opposite direction and died on the spot, he said. Police later recovered the body from the spot and seized both vehicles. Legal action would be taken in this regard, added the OC.>

column4: <Couple dead in Natore road accident>
column5: <A husband and wife couple, who were heading towards Naogaon to visit a relative, died when a human hauler hit them on Ishwardi-Lalpur road in Lalpur upazila of Natore this morning. The deceased were identified as Chandu Molla, 62, and his wife Arobi Begum, 42, both residents of the area. The accident occurred in the morning when a human hauler hit the couple, who were standing by the road, as the driver lost control over the wheel. The husband and wife died on the spot, said Alimul Al Razi, officer-in-charge of Banpara highway Police. Police recovered the bodies and sent them to the local hospital. The couple reached the area in the morning by a train to visit a relative’s house in Naogaon. They met the tragedy while waiting near the road for a vehicle to reach their destination. Meanwhile, ten people were injured in a collision between a bus and a truck at Godhara in Lalpur upazila.>

column4: <Road accident leaves two dead in Barishal>
column5: <Two people were killed and 10 sustained injuries in a head-on collision between a bus and a three-wheeler on Dhaka-Barishal highway in Wazirpur upazila of Barishal this morning. The deceased were identified as Sohrab, 38, and Rubel, 40. Both were residents of Wazirpur upazila. Witnesses and passengers of the bus said that the Sakura Paribahan bus collided with a three-wheeler coming from the opposite direction when it reached Attipara area of Wazirpur upazila. After hitting the three-wheeler, the bus hit a roadside tree that caused the deaths of two passengers and left 8-10 with injuries, including the helper of the bus. The injured were admitted to Barishal Sher-e-Bangla Medical College Hospital. Firoz Alam, Assistant Sub-Inspector of Wazirpur Police Station, said the accident may have been caused due to dense fog. The bodies were sent to Barishal morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <Road accidents leave four people dead in 3 districts>
column5: <At least four people were killed and four others sustained injuries in separate road accidents in three districts on Friday night and Saturday morning. In Bogura, a 20-year-old youth was killed and three others were injured in a road accident when a private car lost its control and hit a roadside tree at Shitolai Club Ghor area of Bogura’s Kahaloo upazila on Friday night. The deceased was identified as Aliur Rahman Alif, 20, a resident of Sutrapur Riyaz Kazi Len area under Bogura district. Selim Reza, officer-in-charge of Kahalu Police Station, said Alif was returning home from Kahaloo driving his car. When he reached Shitolai area, Alif lost control over his steering and crashed into the roadside tree, leaving four people injured. They were rushed to Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital where Alif succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment at the hospital, added the OC. The body was handed over to the family at noon, he added. Meanwhile, a 25-year-old man was killed and another man was injured when a truck hit them at Palsha area of Bogura Sadar upazila on Saturday morning. The deceased Mokaddes Hossain was an employee of a private company from Choto Dangapara village of Hakimpur upazila of Dinajpur district. Confirming the matter, Shahinuzzaman, investigation officer of Bogura Sadar Police Station, said the injured was taken to the Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital. In Chuadanga, a minor boy was killed when an easy bike hit him at Darshana-Mujibnagar road of Chuadanga zilla on Saturday afternoon. The deceased was identified as Abdus Samad, son of Ahad Ali of Pratappur village of Darshana upazila. Eyewitnesses said Samad was playing beside the road. Around 12:30pm, the speeding easy-bike hit him, leaving him dead on the spot. Darshana Police Station’s Officer in charge Biplob Kumar Saha said, police detained the driver and took the easy-bike into police custody. In Lalmonirhat, a man died when a truck hit him at College Mor area of Patgram upazila in Lalmonirhat on Saturday morning. The deceased was identified as Golam Mostofa, 45, from Shamsherpur village of Lalmoniraht’s Patgram upazila. Patgram Police Station’s Officer-in-Charge Ferdoush Wahid confirmed the matter.>
column9: <(roadside tree at Shitolai Club Ghor, NA, Darshana-Mujibnagar road, NA)>
column10: <(Shitolai Club Ghor, Palsha, Chaudanga, College Mor)>

column4: <Road accident leaves election officer dead in Dhaka>
column5: <An election officer died in a road accident as a container lorry hit the motorbike he was on in the Dhaka Airport area last night. The deceased Md Al-Mamun, 48, was posted in Dhaka’s Uttara Election Office. He was son of late Shamsul Haque of Akashi village under Saturia upazila of Manikganj. Sources said the container lorry rammed the bike on Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway in the airport area around 9:30 pm, leaving Mamun critically injured. He was rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital and was later shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) where he succumbed to his injuries around 11:15 pm, said his son Riad Abir. Abir said they live in a rented house on Mohammadpur's Tajmahal Road and his father met the accident while returning home from the Uttara office. DMCH police outpost’s in-charge Md Bachchu Miah said the body was kept at the morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <2 die in road accident in Naogaon>
column5: <Two youths were killed in a head-on collision between a motorbike and a pickup van in Niamatpur upazila of Naogaon district on Wednesday. The deceased were identified as Parvez, 19, son of Sirajul Islam of Tagoril village of Niamatpur upazila and Habib, 20, son of Anarul Islam of Sadar upazila of Chapainawabganj. Locals said that the accident happened around noon when the youths riding on the motorbike collided with the pickup van on Dhansura-Nachol regional road, leaving Habib killed on the spot and Parvez injured critically. He was rushed to Upazila Health Complex where physicians declared him dead, they said. Niyamatpur police station’s inspector (investigation) Kawsar Alam said they detained the pickup van and its driver in this connection. Legal actions will be taken in this regard later, he added.>

column4: <Man killed, 20 injured in Cumilla road accident>
column5: <A 25-year-old man was killed and at least 20 passengers sustained injuries in an accident involving a bus and a tractor in Krishnapur area of Laksam upazila under Cumilla district on Wednesday evening. The deceased was identified as Sifat Hossain, son of Motaleb Hossain of Amishapara area of Sonaimuri Upazila under Noakhali district.  Laksam Police Station Sub-Inspector Borhan Uddin Bhuiyan said a collision between a passenger bus and a tractor left a youth dead and 20 others injured. Meanwhile, the injured were rescued and sent to different hospitals in Laksham. The bus was taken into custody by the highway police station.>

column4: <Two young men killed in separate accidents in Chattogram>
column5: <Separate road accidents killed two youths of similar age in Chattogram’s Raozan and Hathazari upazilas on Saturday. The deceased were identified as Md Elias Mia, 26, son of Mohammad Ali of Janipathar village in Haldia union of Raozan upazila, and Md Tareq, 24, son of Md Ali of Mekhal union under Hathazari upazila. Raozan Highway Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mozammel Haque said that a head-on collision between a bus and a CNG-run autorickshaw in front of Raozan Technical School and College left the autorickshaw driver, Elias Mia, dead on the spot. The accident also caused severe injuries of three auto-rickshaw passengers. The police officer said another accident at Hathazari took the life of Tareq, who was crossing the road when a pick-up van hit him, leaving him severely injured. Later locals took Tareq to Upazila Health Complex but as his situation deteriorated, he was taken to Chittagong Medical College Hospital later. In the afternoon, the youth succumbed to his injuries while undergoing treatment at the hospital. “The pick-up van fled the scene immediately. Process is on to file a case regarding the incident,” the OC said.>
column9: <(front of Raozan Techhnical School and College, NA)>

column4: <3 killed in Dhamrai, Savar road accidents>
column5: <Three people including a recommended Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) cadre were killed and two more injured in separate road accidents in Dhamrai and Savar of Dhaka on Thursday, police said. Two of the deceased were identified as the 41st BCS recommended cadre Md Rubel Parvez and also a former student of Jahangirnagar University and Md Abdul Mannan, a resident of Manikganj. The identities of other deceased and injured could not be known. Police and witnesses said two buses of ‘Selfie Paribahan’ coming to Dhaka from Manikganj raced to overtake each other on the Dhaka-Aricha Highway, causing the accident. One of the buses knocked down three people including Rubel and Mannan who were waiting for a bus at Dhamrai Thana Stand in the morning, leaving one of them dead on the spot and two others critically injured, they said. One of the injured succumbed to his injuries on the way to Dhamrail Upazila Health Complex, said Savar Highway Police Station’s Officer-in-charge Sheikh Abul Hasan. Enraged by the incident, students of Jahangirnagar University seized at least 25 buses of the Selfie Paribahan from the morning to afternoon, the OC said, adding that they brought the situation under control later. On the other hand, a father and his son riding on a motorbike hit a pickup van from behind after losing control in front of Jahangirnagar University, leaving the son dead on the spot and the father injured around noon.>
column9: <(Dhaka-Aricha highway, in front of Jahangirnagar University)>

column4: <Woman killed in road accident at Mirsarai in Ctg>
column5: <A 54-year-old woman was killed when a police microbus carrying an accused hit her on the Dhaka-Chattogram Highway in Mirsarai upazila of Chattogram on Wednesday. The deceased was identified as Firoza Begum, wife of Enamul Hoque of Bhuiyan village under Ichhakhali union of the upazila. Witnesses said the accident happened around noon when the speeding microbus knocked her down while crossing the highway in Thakurdighi area, leaving her critically injured. The woman, who was going to Upazila Health Complex for treatment, succumbed to her injuries on the way to hospital, they said. Sohel Sarkar, in-charge of Jorarganj Highway Police Station, said that the body was brought to the police station and it would be handed over to the family after completing legal procedures.>

column4: <Road accident leaves grandfather and granddaughter dead in Chattogram>
column5: <Two motorcycle riders were killed and another woman was injured as a brick loaded truck hit a motorcycle at Nayapara area of Lohagara upazila under Chattogram on Monday afternoon. The deceased were identified as motorcycle rider Md Iqbal, 57, and his 7-year-old grand-daughter. Lohagara Fire Service Station in-charge Rabiul Alam confirmed the matter and said a man and his granddaughter died and a woman got injuries from the accident. “On information, our team carried out a rescue operation immediately and recovered the bodies. The injured woman was taken to the hospital,” he said.>

column4: <Madrasha student killed in Ctg road accident>
column5: <A 6-year-old madrasha student was killed and another injured as a pickup van hit an auto-rickshaw  carrying them at South Maghadia Ghona in Mirsharai upazila of Chattogram on Saturday morning. The deceased was identified as Arifa, daughter of Mohammad Imam Hossain and a student of local Khearhat Nooria Siddiqia Dakhil Madrasha while the injured  was  Reena Akter Ankhi, a student of first-grade in the same madrasha. According to locals, the pickup van hit the auto-rickshaw when they were going to the madrasha around 9 am, leaving Arifa dead on the spot. Maulana Mohammad Mofizur Rahman, principal of Khairhat Nuria Siddiqia Dakhil Madrasa, said Arifa died on the spot and injured Rina Akter Ankhi was admitted to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).>

column4: <Four of a family among 15 dead, scores injured in road accidents across country>
column5: <At least 15 people including four of a family were killed and scores injured in road crashes in Satkhira, Chattogram, Gazipur, Feni, Rajshahi, Manikganj, Lalmonirhat districts of the country since morning to evening on Saturday. The deceased included two women, an eight-month-old boy, a police constable, two Indian nationals and three workers, among others. In Satkhira, two Indian nationals died when a truck rammed into a private car at Taltala in Sadar upazila in the morning. The deceased were identified as Asim Kumar Biswas, 45, and Chobi Biswas, 42, of Siliguri in India’s West Bengal. Asim was the deputy manager of Khulna-Mongla port rail line project. He was on his way to India through Bhomra land port. In Chattogram, three workers of a contractor firm were killed and another was injured when a lorry knocked them down on Dhaka-Chattogram Highway on Talbaria BISIC road in Mirsarai upazila of the district. The ill-fated people were Alamgir alias Alam, 45, Shafiqul Islam, 42 and Masud Mia, 35. Sohel Sarkar, officer-in-charge of Jorarganj Highway Police Station, confirmed the incident saying that four workers were installing a pipeline of Karnaphuli Gas Distribution Company on the east side of the highway. In Gazipur, a police constable met a tragic end and his two colleagues sustained injuries when a police van veered off after being hit by a lorry at Rajendrapur Chourasta in Gazipur district in the early morning. Victim Bitan Barua was posted at Gazipur Metropolitan Police as a constable. In Feni, two people including the eight-month-old boy were killed and four members of a family were injured in a road accident in Fulgazi upazila of Feni in the morning. The deceased were identified as an autorickshaw driver Saiful Islam, 22, of Haripuskarni village under the Fulgazi upazila of the district and eight-month-old Anas, son of Akram Hossain of Chiora village in Chauddagram upazila of Cumilla. The injured were the baby’s father Akram Hossain, mother Jannatul Munni, brother Hashim Bin Akram and maternal grandfather Jamal Uddin.Akram along with his family went to the house of his father-in-law to Pubro Basantopur village in the Fulgazi upazila from Cumilla’s Chauddogram upazila a few days back. In Rajshahi, the most shocking road accident of the day happened in Rajshahi’s Puthia upazila on Saturday afternoon. Five people including four of a family were killed and another was injured in a collision between a truck and a CNG autorickshaw in the upazila. The deceased were identified as Insab Ali, 75, his son Ayub Ali, 38, his sister Parvin, 35, Parveen's daughter Sharmin, 17, and autorickshaw driver Mokles Ali, 45. The four members of the family were going to Rajshahi city from Kantapur village in Gurdaspur upazila of Natore for the treatment. In Manikganj, a 60-year-old man was killed in a road crash at Paturia's Ferryghat area in Shibaloy upazila. Deceased Rafiqul Islam was a resident of Khorshedpur area of Kushtia's Kumarkhali upazila, Anwar Hossain, sub-inspector of Shibaloy Police Station, confirmed it. In Lalmonirhat, another sexagenarian Abiz Uddin Munshi, an imam of a mosque in Lalmonirhat' Kaliganj, was killed in a collision between an auto-rickshaw and a motorcycle. The accident occurred at Sirajul Market area of Kakina union of the upazila on Saturday afternoon. Kaliganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Imtiaz Kabir confirmed the death of Imam in the accident.>

column4: <Sexagenarian killed in Manikganj road accident>
column5: <A 60-year-old man was killed in a road accident at Paturia's Ferryghat area in Shibaloy upazila of Manikganj. The accident occurred around 12 noon on Saturday (November 26). The deceased was identified as Rafiqul Islam , a resident of Khorshedpur area of Kushtia's Kumarkhali upazila. Anwar Hossain , Sub-Inspector (SI) of Shibaloy Police Station, said Rafiqul Islam was walking through ghat number 5 to get on the ferry. Suddenly, a truck hit him, leaving him seriously injured. Locals rescued him and took him to Shibaloy Upazila Health Complex where doctors declared him dead upon arrival. The body was sent to Manikganj District Hospital morgue for an autopsy, added the officer. Police seized the truck but its driver managed to flee. A case was registered at Shibaloy police station in this regard, said the SI.>

column4: <Four of a family among 5 dead in Rajshahi road accident>
column5: <Five people including four of a family were killed and another was injured in a collision between a truck and a CNG autorickshaw in Puthia upazila of Rajshahi this afternoon, said police. The deceased were identified as Insab Ali, 75, his son Ayub Ali, 38, his sister Parvin, 35, Parveen's daughter Sharmin, 17, and autorickshaw driver Mokles Ali, 45. The four members of the family were passengers of the autorickshaw and were going to Rajshahi city from Kantapur village in Gurdaspur upazila of Natore for the treatment. Driver Mokles hailed from Mokimpur village of the same upazila. The injured Hridoy, 19, was the helper of the truck and is undergoing treatment at Rajshahi Medical College Hospital (RMCH). Mamunur Rashid, officer-in-charge of Puthia police station, confirmed the development saying that the accident occurred around 2pm when the Puthia-bound truck loaded-with TCB goods crashed into the autorickshaw in Belpukur Bypass Crossing. As a result, both the vehicles plunged into a roadside ditch leaving one dead on the spot and five others injured, he said. The injured were rushed to the RMCH where physicians declared the four dead, he said, adding that the trucker managed to flee.>

column4: <2 Indian nationals die in Satkhira road accident>
column5: <Two Indian nationals died when a truck rammed into a private car at Taltala in Sadar upazila of Satkhira district on Saturday. The deceased were identified as Asim Kumar Biswas, 45, and Chobi Biswas, 42, of Siliguri in India’s West Bengal. Asim was the deputy manager of Khulna-Mongla port rail line project. He was on his way to India through Bhomra land port. Md Saifuzzaman, sub-assistant director of Satkhira Fire Service, said the accident occurred at 8 am in front of BGB headquarters in Sadar upazila when the Khulna-bound truck hit the private car, leaving it mangled and two passengers and the driver in it injured. They were taken to Satkhira Sadar Hospital where the doctors declared the two Indian citizens dead.>

column4: <3 die in separate accidents in Feni>
column5: <Three people died in separate accidents in Feni on Thursday night and Friday morning. Two of the deceased were identified as Md Shah Poran, 35, and Faruk Uddin, 23. Another man who died this morning could not be identified yet. Quoting locals, police said, the unidentified man died after a speedy covered van hit a cng run autorickshaw on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway. Another man was injured in the accident. Two passengers of the autorickshaw were taken to Feni Sadar Hospital where the duty doctor declared one dead. Md Shah Poran died in an accident at Dagonbhuiyan upazila. His motorcycle lost control as a tire burst suddenly. He was rushed to Feni Sadar Hospital where the doctor declared him dead. Faruk Uddin died in an accident that took place around 10:30 am on Thursday at Bisik Mor area of Sadar upazila. He was on his way to Feni town, where the autorickshaw he was riding was hit by a speedy truck. He was taken to Feni Sadar Hospital and later referred to Chattogram Medical College and Hospital (CMCH). He died on the way to CMCH around 8 pm on Thursday. Mostafa Kamal, officer-in-charge of Mohipal Highway Police Station said, their bodies have been kept in the Feni Sadar Hospital Morgue for autopsy.>

column4: <Two policemen killed in Faridpur road accident>
column5: <Two policemen were killed when a CNG auto-rickshaw carrying them overturned on the Faridpur-Barishal highway Friday morning. The accident took place around 4:30 am in the Bhanga area on the Faridpur-Barishal highway, said Bhanga Police Station Officer-in-Charge Ziarul Islam. The deceased were identified as Nayek Nazmul Hossain and Constable Nasir Uddin. Five members of the highway police left for Faridpur in a CNG autorickshaw to attend a firing exercise. The CNG auto-rickshaw overturned in front of the Brothers Filling Station when it came to Pukuria area of Bhangar and caused casualties. Four others, including the driver, were injured in the incident. Three of the four injured were identified as Imran Sardar, Zakid Hossain and Mithoaiching Marma. The identity of the auto driver could not be known immediately. They were taken to Faridpur Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical College Hospital for better treatment, said OC Ziarul.>
column9: <Faridpur-Barishal highway in front of the Brothers Filling Station>

column4: <3 killed in separate road accidents in Ctg>
column5: <Three people including two students were killed and two others injured in separate road accidents in Chattogram's Patiya,  Fatikchhari and Chandanaish upazilas on Sunday night and Monday morning. The deceased were identified as Tairin Tabassum Toha,9, Noor Hossain ,13 and Montu Kar, 50. In Fatikchhari, primary school student Tairin Tabassum Toha was killed and two were injured after being hit by a 'Chander Gari'( a vehicle that usually carries tourists) in Nazirhat area on Monday morning. Locals said the three students were going to the school around 9:30am. The accident occurred when the vehicle hit the trio, leaving them injured. They were rescued and taken to Nazirhat Health Complex where Toha succumbed to her injuries, said Upazila Health and Family Planning Officer Dr. Arefin Azim. One of the injured was sent to Chittagong Medical College and Hospital, he added. In Chandanaish, Noor Hossain died after being hit by a speeding CNG auto-rickshaw in front of Barma College  around 8:30 am. Police detained driver Md Jahangir ,32, and seized the auto-rickshaw, said Obaidul Islam , officer-in-charge of  Chandanaish police station. Legal action will be taken in this regard, added the OC. Meanwhile, 50-year-old Montu Kar died on the spot after being hit by a speeding bus in Chattogram’s Patiya upazila on Sunday night. The accident occurred around 10:30pm when a speeding bus of  Eagle Paribahan hit him on Chittagong -Cox's Bazar highway. “Montu Kar died on the spot,” said Md Moniruzzaman, sub-inspector of Patiya Crossing Highway Police Station. Police recovered the body from the spot and sent it to the morgue, he said, adding that the bus was seized but the driver and his helper managed to flee.>
column9: <(NA, in front of Barma College, Chittagong -Cox's Bazar highway)>

column4: <2 die in separate road accidents in Ctg>
column5: <Two people, including a motorcyclist, died in separate road accidents at Mirsharai, on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway. The incidents happened in Baradarogahat and Chhota Kamaldah areas of the upazila on Saturday morning and afternoon. The deceased were identified as Yusuf, 42, a truck driver's assistant, and Basu Deb (36) of Durgapur union under Zorarganj kKhan of the upazila. Alamgir Hossain, officer-in-charge (OC) of Kumira Highway Police Station, confirmed the matter. According to locals, Basu died when an unidentified vehicle hit him on the Chattogram-bound lane at Chhota Kamaldah area of Mirsharai at 4 pm. Earlier in the morning, Yousuf died when a truck hit his parked truck from behind in Baradarogtat area, said Deputy Assistant Director of Agrabad Fire Service and Civil Defence Abdur Razzaque. The bodies of the deceased were sent to Chattogram Medical College morgue, said the OC.>
column9: <(the Chattogram-bound lane of Dhaka-Chattogram highway, Dhaka-Chattogram highway)>

column4: <3 die in separate accidents in Dinajpur>
column5: <Three people died in two separate accidents in Dinajpur on Friday. Among the deceased, two people, including the driver of a covered van, were killed when a pick-up van hit their vehicle at Phulbari upazila in Dinajpur. The deceased were identified as Nayeb Ali, 45 and Shafiul Zaman, 28, of Thakurgaon. Rezaul Karim, sub-inspector of Phulbari Police Station, said a Dhaka-bound pick-up van hit the back of the covered van at Dangapara near the headquarters of BGB's 29 battalion in Phulbari upazila on Gobindaganj regional highway in Dinajpur around 3am on Friday. The speeding pickup truck lost control while going in the same direction and caused the incident, said SI Rezaul. Meanwhile, a 103-year-old man died when a Panchagarh-bound Panchagarh Express train hit him near Chirirbandar railway station in Dinajpur around 7:30am on Friday. The deceased was identified as Zehar Uddin. Railway Police Station Sub-Inspector Zahir Raihan said the man, who was hearing impaired, was hit by the train while crossing the rail line.>
column9: <(near the headquarters of BGB's 29 battalion on Gobindaganj regional highway, near Chirirbandar railway station)>

column4: <2 die in Cumilla road accident>
column5: <Two women were killed as a truck hit them while crossing the road on the Dhaka-Chattogram highway at Shabdalpur area of Daudkandi upazila of Cumilla on on Wednesday. The deceased were identified as Nasima Begum, 50, daughter of Ayat Ali of Baura area of Debidwar upazila of Comilla, and her aunt Monowara Begum, 80, of Babutipara area of Muradnagar upazila of the same district. Abdur Rahim, sub-inspector of Eliotganj Highway Police Outpost, said the accident occurred when a Dhaka-bound truck hit them while they were crossing the highway in the area, leaving the both dead on the spot. The body has been handed over to the family, he said.>

column4: <Two killed in Rangamati road accident>
column5: <Two people were killed and 4 others were injured in a road accident at Bhedbhedi area in Rangamati on Saturday. The deceased were identified as Puri Chakma and Gunimala Chakma. The identities of the injured could not be ascertained immediately. The accident occurred when a passenger bus coming from Chattogram hit a CNG autorickshaw in Bhedbhedi area, leaving two passengers of the CNG dead and four others injured,  said Ariful Amin, officer-in-charge (OC) of Rangamati Kotwali police station. Locals rescued the injured and brought them to Rangamati Sadar Hospital immediately. Shawkat Akbar, resident doctor at the hospital, said the injured are now receiving treatment. Of them, one has been sent to Chittagong for better treatment. Legal action will be taken in this regard, said the police officer.>

column4: <3 motorcyclists killed in Chattogram road accident>
column5: <Three motorcyclists were killed and one was injured in a road accident on Dhaka-Chittagong highway in Chattogram's Mirsarai upazila on Saturday. The accident took place at Kamaldah Bazar in the upazila when an unidentified vehicle hit the motorbike, said the witnesses. The identities of the deceased could not be known yet. Alamgir Hossain, sub-inspector of Kumira Highway Police Station, said more details will be provided later.>

column4: <Father, son killed in Madaripur road accident>
column5: <A 60-year-old man and his son were killed when a covered van hit a three-wheeler on Madaripur-Shariatpur regional highway at Mather Bazar in Sadar upazila of Madaripur district on Tuesday evening. The deceased were identified as Mahadeb Pal and his son Mithun Pal, 28, of Tekerhat village in the upazila. The accident occurred in the evening when the covered van hit a three-wheeler while the father and son were heading to Madaripur, leaving them dead on the spot, said Salauddin Ahmed, officer-in-charge of Sadar Police Station. On information, police recovered the bodies and arrested the covered van driver.>

column4: <Pabna road accident leaves 2 dead>
column5: <Two people were dead and two were injured in an accident involving a truck, a CNG run auto-rickshaw and a shallow engine on Ishwardi-Baneshwar road in Ishwardi upazila of Pabna district this morning. The deceased were identified as Ahsan Molla, 65, of Bagha upazila in Rajshahi district and Abdul Malek, 30, son of Ala Mandal of Ishwardi upazila. Quoting local, Arbindo Sarkar, officer-in-charge of Ishwardi Police Station, said the accident occurred in the morning near Govt. Sara Marwari Model School and College when the truck, CNG-run auto-rickshaw and a shallow engine crashed into each other, leaving two passengers of the three wheeler dead on the spot and two injured. The injured were taken to Rajshahi Medical College and Hospital.>
column9: <Ishwardi-Baneshwar road near Govt. Sara Marwari Model School and College>

column4: <UP member dies, Jubo League leader injured in Ctg road accident>
column5: <A union parishad member died and a Jubo League leader was injured after a SUV collided head-on with a motorcycle in Rangunia upazila of Chattogram on Monday. The incident happened in the Ward-2 Battal area of the Padua union of the upazila on Monday afternoon. The deceased was identified as Helal Uddin (38), a ward member of Kuhlang union of Bandarban Sadar upazila. The injured is Nurunnabi (40) of Pukuria Bridgeghata village in Rangunia and joint general secretary of The union Jubo League. Mirza Mohammad Hasan, officer-in-charge (OC) of South Rangunia Police Station, confirmed the matter. Two people on the motorcycle were seriously injured after colliding with the SUV. They were taken to the Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared Helal dead, said the OC. Nurunnabi has been sent to Chattogram Medical College Hospital for better treatment. Helal's body has been handed over to his family. The SUV has been seized. A case of unnatural death will be filed at the police station, added the police official.>

column4: <Child killed in Khulna road accident>
column5: <A six-year-old child died after being hit by a battery-run easy bike while crossing the road in Khulna's  Paikgacha on Saturday morning. The deceased was identified as Samim Islam, son of Md Islam, a resident of Narnia village in Dumuria upazila. Biswajit, sub-inspector (SI) of Paikgacha police station confirmed the death. Sohrab Gazi, the grandfather of the deceased, said that Samim came to visit their house to attend his uncle's wedding. On Saturday morning, Samim suffered serious injuries in the head after he was hit by the easy bike while crossing the road. Locals rescued and took him to Kapilmuni Hospital where doctors declared Samim dead, Sohrab Gazi said. On information, Local UP Chairman Kawsar Ali Joaddar along with UP members visited the spot. Locals caught the vehicle but its driver managed to flee.>

column4: <College student killed in Chattogram road accident>
column5: <A college student was killed in a road accident at Chunti Jangalia area of Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway area of Lohagara upazila under Chattogram district around 8:30pm on Friday. The deceased was identified as Junaidur Rahman Rony, 21, a second-year college student of Chattogram Government Model School and College and son of Late Saleh Ahmed of Rahmania para of Chunti Union. Khan Mohammad Erfan, officer-in-charge (OC) of Dohazari Highway Police Station, said the college student was killed when a Cox's Bazar-bound bus hit a motorcycle on Friday evening. “The body of the deceased has been handed over to his family on behalf of the request to give the body without a post-mortem. The bus was seized, but the driver managed to flee the scene,” he added.>
column9: <Chunti Jangalia area of Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway>

column4: <2 dead, 6 injured in Moulvibazar road crash>
column5: <Two people were killed and six others injured in a collision between a CNG-run autorickshaw and a minibus in Sadar upazila of Moulvibazar on Friday afternoon. The deceased were identified as auto rickshaw driver Abas Miah, 65, a resident of Brahmanpara under Sadar upazila and passenger Madhu Miah, 60, of the same area. The injured are Madhu Miah’s daughters Sumi Begum, 40, Meghna Begum, 42, granddaughters Mim Akhter, 18, Suma Begum, 12, Faiza, 3, and grandson Fahim, 12. Quoting locals, Moulvibazar Model Police Station’s Officer-in-Charge KM Nazrul said the accident happened around 2:45 pm when the speeding minibus knocked the autorickshaw from the opposite direction in Durlavpur area, leaving the two dead on the spot and six others critically injured. Four of the injured were sent to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital while the rest were undergoing treatment at Moulvibazar 250-bed hospital, he said. All victims except the auto driver were members of a family and they were going to a relative’s house, he added.>

column4: <Bus driver killed in Dhaka road crash>
